##### Project general facts

Barari Palace stands as a modern landmark shaped by elegance, calm, and purposeful design, rising at the edge of Al Barari’s iconic greenery. Its architecture blends quiet sophistication with timeless simplicity — warm tones, soft textures, and fluid geometries come together to create a serene retreat moments from the city yet worlds away from its noise. The residential offering includes studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive Sky Villas, all crafted with airy volumes, expansive windows, and layouts centered on clarity, comfort, and refined contemporary living.

Life at Barari Palace unfolds around a curated selection of amenities that elevate both wellness and social connection. Residents enjoy a tranquil beach pool, a stylish clubhouse with a rooftop lounge, a performance-focused fitness centre, sauna and steam rooms, children’s play areas, and community gardens designed to bring people together. Each feature is introduced with intention, forming a lifestyle that balances relaxation, movement, and meaningful moments within a beautifully landscaped environment.

Interiors are shaped by a philosophy of quiet luxury, featuring modern finishing with high-quality materials that enhance warmth, elegance, and natural light. Kitchens are designed with streamlined cabinetry, natural materials, and subtle lighting that blend performance with beauty, while all homes are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their sanctuary. With its composed aesthetic and crafted detailing, Barari Palace becomes a place where every day begins with clarity and ends in calm.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Majan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
